add_model_record_hook: add a model record hook to a PyTorch nn.Module to capture activations and parameters during forward pass
compare_hook_items: compare recorded hook items between two model hooks and return a list of differences
print_hook_items_difference: print the differences between two model record hooks to stdout for debugging model divergence
test_model_record_hook: test that two independently initialized models produce different hook recordings and detect 3 differences
test_model_record_hook_same_model: test that two deep-copied identical models produce zero hook recording differences after forward pass
